endorsements.quote: Training should therefore support critical engagement with AI while reinforcing the relational and interpretive skills fundamental to recognising dying ( Table 1 ).

unlisted_practices: Invest in data collection and research to verify the accuracy of clinical prognostic tools and to train AI on reliable end-of-life outcome data.
Integrate prognostic tools for recognising dying into NHS computer systems so that care can be coordinated and data collected to improve them.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/discussion paper on the ethical, practical, and governance considerations of using AI for predicting dying and palliative care needs.
